description: An older grey-haired man in a pale toga sits on a wooden chair in a marble colonnaded hall lined with scroll shelves, reading and writing on a long unrolled scroll. Behind him on the right, a painted wall mural shows two crowned figures clasping arms, a wolf above them, a burning city with smoke, and Roman legionaries with red shields and spears. Other robed figures stand in the background. The scroll marks are illegible, and a small sparkle logo sits in the bottom-right corner. The painting runs edge to edge with no frame.
reason: Shows an ancient Roman scholar reading in a colonnaded library, with a mural of Roman legionaries and a burning city.
